scripts.__comment_of_start_scripts: these are scripts that are only runnable in a GCP enviornment for both development and production environment
scripts.__comment_of_cross_env_scripts: these are cross platform scripts for development and production to be run on any machine for development purposes
scripts.serve:dev: npm run lint && npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r source-map-support/register ./dist/bin/www
scripts.serve:prod: npm run lint && npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./dist/bin/www
scripts.serve:local: npm run lint && npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=local node ./dist/bin/www
scripts.__comment_on_db_reset_scripts: these are the scripts for resetting the development environment database
scripts.reset_db:dev: npm run lint && npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r source-map-support/register ./dist/db/test/clearDatabase.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r source-map-support/register ./dist/db/test/populate.js
scripts.reset_db:local: npm run lint && npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=local node -r source-map-support/register ./dist/db/test/clearDatabase.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=local node -r source-map-support/register ./dist/db/test/populate.js
